Cybersecurity Governance The Board has delegated to its Risk Oversight Committee (the “ROC”) responsibility for overseeing the Company’s cyber and technology-related risks, including network security, information and digital security, data privacy and protection, and risks related to emerging technologies such as AI and machine learning; the technologies, policies, processes, and practices for managing and mitigating such risks; and the Company’s cyber incident response and recovery plan.
